Spray Dried Blueberry Powder for Food and Beverage Manufacturers

Blueberry powder gives products a deep purple-blue colour and a sweet, slightly tart berry flavour without the handling issues of fresh or frozen fruit. Tradenest Naturals supplies spray dried blueberry powder to beverage, confectionery, bakery and supplement manufacturers. We spray dry blueberry juice into a fine, quick-dissolving powder that is easy to store and dose. It suits brands that want the same colour and taste in every production run, all year round.

How the Powder Is Made

We begin with ripe blueberries, carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. First, the fruit is washed and pressed to extract the juice. Next, the juice goes through a spray dryer. Fine droplets are sprayed into warm air, and the moisture evaporates almost instantly. Because the drying is so quick, the natural colour, aroma and flavour of the berries are well preserved. The result is a powder with a fresh, recognisable blueberry profile. Temperatures are controlled closely throughout the drying cycle. The exact composition, including any drying carrier used, is stated in the product specification sheet.

Why Choose Our Blueberry Powder?

As a spray dried blueberry powder manufacturer, we focus on the details that matter in a factory. Our powder dissolves well in both hot and cold liquids. Its fine particle size helps it blend evenly into dry mixes. As a result, you can reduce clumping and the downtime that comes with it. We also offer a fair spray dried blueberry powder price for bulk buyers, so you can protect your margins without changing your recipe. Our minimum order is just 5 Kg.

Technical Specifications and Quality

We keep our quality process practical and transparent. Every lot is checked for moisture, colour and particle size before packing. Moisture is held below 5%, and the powder is sieved to 80-100 mesh. If you are looking for a dependable bulk spray dried blueberry powder supplier india, our records support full batch traceability. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We are an FSSAI licensed food business and IEC registered exporter, and we provide export documentation support with each order.

Versatile Industrial Applications

Our spray dried blueberry powder fits many product categories. Beverage companies use it in smoothies, drink mixes and flavoured waters. Confectioners add it for natural colour and flavour in gummies and candies. Bakers use it in muffins, breads, pastries and fillings. Supplement brands use it as a fruit flavour base in drink powders and chewables. Because it is concentrated, a small amount goes a long way. That makes it a cost-effective choice for larger production volumes.

Frequently Asked Questions for B2B Buyers

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried blueberry powder? Our MOQ is 5 Kg. Private label runs may need higher volumes depending on the pack format. Contact us for a quote based on your needs. What documents and quality standards apply? We follow hygienic processing practices and keep batch records. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We also support you with the documents needed for customs clearance. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We use moisture-resistant export packaging, including bulk bags, stand-up pouches and HDPE containers. The shelf life is 18-24 months when stored cool and dry. What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, processing)? The standard powder is spray dried to 80-100 mesh, with moisture below 5%. This gives good stability and easy dispersion. How do I request a sample or quote? Use our website contact form to ask for a sample or a formal quote. Samples are available on request, and we reply promptly.
